title: Failureship
tagline: Deliver nothing. Demonstrate everything. Get promoted.
goal: Your goal: get promoted, seat by seat, to the top of Floor 3. Work out who really decides.
resultSpent: Done: {place}. That action is spent, and you have {actions} left. Click your next place on the floor.
resultSpentLast: Done: {place}. That was your last action this month.
inboxEmpty: Your inbox is clear. Click a place on the floor.
inboxTag: Inbox · {n} to answer before the month closes
inboxNoAnswer: No actions left to answer this. It goes unanswered as the month closes.
tooNarrowText: This window is too narrow for the office. Widen it to at least 1280 pixels, or use a larger screen. The game is made for 1920 by 1080.
mailDisclaimer: Please consider the environment before printing this e-mail.
promisesEmpty: You have promised nobody anything. It was a position.
favoursHeading: Favours, yours and owed to you

gaugeTitles.teflon: Teflon, out of 100: how well blame slides off you. It is your track record, not how safe you are. Press to see what moved it.
gaugeTitles.fawning: Fawning, out of 100: how well sucking up to your managers is paying off. Not whether they like you, and no help to a promotion. Press to see what moved it.

gaugesNoMoves: Nothing has come back on you yet, so nothing has moved it. It is your track record, not how safe you are or how anyone feels about you.
resultsNoMilestones: None. You can compare this with your friends.
resultsNoRivals: Nobody, as far as anyone can tell. Everyone was exactly as supportive as they looked.
resultsNoGrandPlans: None of your bosses had one. They had a vision instead, which needs no deadline.
resultsDealsHeading: What your Deals were really worth
resultsEscapesHeading: How you got out of it
resultsBeliefsHeading: What each of them ended up believing, and why
resultsHeardNothing: Nothing about you ever reached them.
resultsNoFact: Nothing. Exactly what it looked like.
notebookEmpty: Nothing yet. The page has the company logo on it.
resultsFactEventsHeading: What a Hidden Fact did to you
resultsBossHeading: Your boss, and what your choices did for them
resultsBossNoChoices: You did nothing your boss noticed. It was a position.
resultsHeadHeading: Your boss's boss, and what they really made of you
resultsNoClaims: You asked nobody anything. It was a position.
resultsChartsHeading: The Org Chart, and the Power Map
seedRefused: "{seed}" cannot be used as a seed. A seed is a whole number, from 0 to 4294967295.
leaveBody: You are in month {month}. Nothing about this run will be kept, which is also the company's position on it.
saveLostTitle: Your file could not be located
saveLostBody: The company has changed its systems since you last logged in, and your record does not fit the new form. There is no one to appeal to. You have been re-onboarded from the start of your probation, which is standard.

hints.actions: Click a place on the floor, or its label. You have {actions} left, and then the month closes. Your project, the Notebook and the Org Chart are free.
hints.inbox: Answer your inbox in any order, and use the floor as you like: you have {actions} left. Each answer shows what it costs. The month closes once your actions are spent and nothing is left to answer ({n} to go).
hints.inboxOnly: Your actions are spent. The month cannot close until you answer your inbox: {n} still to answer.
hints.find-out: Choose who to ask about. Think about who is telling you, and what they might want. The action is already spent.
hints.scene: Read the room: who interrupts, who gets looked at, who gets ignored. No single sign settles what anyone is, so watch over the months. Then choose how to behave.
hints.notice: Read the result, then press Continue.
hints.escape: This has come back on you, from something you did. Choose a way out, or take it. A way out can fail, and failing is worse than taking it.
hints.story: The month has closed. Read what landed and what was reported, then press Continue to move on.
hints.win: You have reached the top. Read what it comes to, then press Continue for the results.
hints.results: The run is over. Read what really happened, then play this seed again or start a new run.

results.title: Your probation has been extended
results.intro: Your review period is over. A form says you are meeting expectations, and that the expectations are under review. Here is what the form leaves out.

liftRideBody: Floor {from}. The doors close. There is music, which nobody chose. Floor {to}.
